The whole leaves and flowers separated from the previously dried stems of Thymus vulgaris, or T. zygis, or a mixture of both species. It contains not less than 12 mL/kg of essential oil, of which a minimum of 40% is thymol and car- vacrol, both calculated with reference to the anhydrous drug.
